body: Flag: MOSTLY-CLEAN (one long-running quid-pro-quo allegation). Dalmia Bharat (cement; consolidated subsidiaries Dalmia Cement (Bharat) and earlier OCL India) and Dalmia Bharat Sugar. Listed-company record: periodic simplification (2018-19 merger of Odisha Cement and the holdco into Dalmia Bharat), buybacks/dividends, no promoter pledging; aggressive capacity expansion via IBC bids (lost Jaiprakash Associates to Adani, 2025-26; acquired Murli Industries and parts of Binani). Allegation: the 2011 CBI case in the Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy disproportionate-assets matter alleges Dalmia Cement invested ~Rs 95 cr in Bharathi Cement in return for limestone leases from the Andhra Pradesh government; ED provisionally attached Reddy's shares (~Rs 27.5 cr) and Dalmia Cement land (ED value ~Rs 377 cr; DCBL said ~Rs 793 cr) on 31-Mar-2025; the PMLA Appellate Tribunal partly allowed DCBL's appeal, cutting attributable proceeds of crime from ~Rs 793 cr to ~Rs 92.5 cr; ED reportedly released attached land on 21-Apr-2026 (secondary source). This is an unproven criminal allegation 15 years old; no conviction. Older Dalmia family history (Ramkrishna Dalmia's 1950s conviction; the separate Sanjay Dalmia/GHCL and Vishnu Hari Dalmia branches) should not be conflated with this group. Investor read: operating governance acceptable; political-licensing risk in mining-heavy businesses.

data.allegations: CBI 2011 / ED 2025 Jagan Reddy quid-pro-quo (pending; proceeds reduced by tribunal)
